integrity: All combinatorial, Morse, free-face, and symmetry certificates are standalone, finite, and reproducible. Same-model review only; no external proof certification, authorship attribution, or independence is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for the 14-vertex rhombic-dodecahedral graph at scales 2 and 3. No equivariant simple-homotopy claim; only the induced integral homology character is computed. The scale-2 kernel is an abstract free abelian group, with no integral group-module decomposition claimed. No extension to other graphs/scales or independent external audit.
